QuestInfo.name: Reason for the Golem's Change
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bChief Stan#k who is deep in thought about the change in the Golems.
QuestInfo.1: Chief Stan says that it might be able get some hints from #p1012108#. He wants you to ask #b#p1012108##k if she remembers anything. She is a sensitive girl so ask her carefully.
QuestInfo.2: #p1012108# says that she saw Golems jumping out of a door with a strange puppet sitting on top...

0.0: I just can't figure out why the Golems are behaving like this. I wonder if it has to do with a puppet, like the other incidents that have occurred... I guess we have no other option than to ask #p1012108#.
0.1: Please go talk to #b#p1012108##k and ask if she remembers anything... Anything at all. She's probably in shock right now, so comfort her a little while you're at it, would you?

yes.0: Please be nice to her. She's very fragile.

no.0: Hmph, don't you want to ask her? You two know each other, so #p1012108# might be more willing to share what she saw with you.

1.0: Oh, Evan! I was so out of it that I forgot to thank you. Am I okay? Of course. I'm a little shaken up but I'm fine. What brings you here?\r\n#L0##bHm, I wanted to ask you something. Did you see anything when you were in Golem's Temple? Anything that seemed out of place or strange?#l\n#k
1.1: Well, I don't know if it's out of the ordinary or not, but I did see a door with a puppet sitting on top. I saw a lot of Golems jumping out of that door. Is that strange?\r\n#L0##bGolems from that door? Were they average Golems? Or were they reddish Golems?#l\n#k
1.2: All the Golems I saw were reddish. Are there other types? Anyway, that's all I can tell you. I hope it helps.

yes.0: By the way, how did you get so strong? You weren't this strong when you, me, and #p1013101# used to play together. What's your secret? Okay, okay, I'll stop prying.

npc.0: Have you gone to see #b#p1012108##k yet? She's getting her rest in town.
